entities.summary: Deon Marshall Thompson is an American-Ivorian professional basketball player who played for Kesatria Bengawan Solo of the Indonesian Basketball League (IBL). He played college basketball for the North Carolina Tar Heels. Standing at 2.04 m, he plays the power forward position.
